item.title: Broncos’ Sean Payton handing play calling duties to Davis Webb: ‘I think he has a gift’
item.description: Sean Payton is stepping into a new phase of his head coaching career. He announced Tuesday that he's giving play calling duties to 31-year-old offensive coordinator Davis Webb.

item.title: NFL Combine: Broncos’ Sean Payton says he’s ‘already’ pushed for an extension for GM George Paton
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS, Ind. -- The way that Sean Payton speaks about Broncos general manager George Paton in public these days, one would think they're filming their very own buddy-comedy series in Denver.

item.title: Diamondbacks’ Nolan Arenado ‘will be a force’ in NL West, Rockies’ Warren Schaeffer says
item.description: "My expectations are high, and they are high for this group," Arenado said.

item.title: Douglas County adopts law requiring stores to report theft — but drops fines for failing to do so
item.description: "When corporate policies prevent or discourage the reporting of theft, it limits our ability to investigate, identify patterns and hold offenders accountable," DougCo Sheriff Darren Weekly said.

item.title: Renck: Broncos’ Sean Payton made right move giving up play-calling. How long before he calls an audible?
item.description: Is this Albert Einstein handing over the chalkboard equation to Will Hunting? Or did Webb just land the worst sports job in Denver besides Rockies pitching coach?

item.title: President Donald Trump’s State of the Union is strong as he delivers safety to Colorado (Opinion)
item.description: "Trump is reversing the many years of rising crime and chaos inflicted on families under Democrat rule. Denver saw one of the highest drops in homicide rates in the nation." -- U.S. Rep. Gabe Evans

item.title: Measles case confirmed in Denver International Airport passenger who visited Littleton church
item.description: Public health officials are providing free measles vaccinations to people who were potentially exposed at the church service starting Wednesday morning.

item.title: State of the Union offers Trump a chance to make the case for his foreign policy approach
item.description: He's making the case to Americans who are increasingly uneasy about his priorities.

item.title: Colorado Buffs women’s basketball tripped up by Utah in home finale
item.description: Going into Tuesday night, the Colorado women’s basketball team was in the driver’s seat to earn a top four seed in the Big 12 Tournament. Now, the Buffs need some help.
